svg.title: Purpose & work · CyberAlchemy Lab concept map
svg.desc: Choose a response to a need and a success test. Record the product outcome, selected software and particular project effort separately. Select a node for its role, example and connections. Arrows are explanatory role connections.

g.title: An attributable selection names what will address the intent.
The chosen response may address a product or one of the outcomes it offers.
Each capability belongs to one product and states a consumer outcome.
The chosen project organizes the particular work required for the response.
Project work is directed toward declared goals.
Work belongs to the selected project coordination.
Work results are assessed against declared targets.
Assessment records what the work achieved and what remains unresolved.
A separate binding record identifies the selected capability and implementation versions.
The binding record identifies the specific implementation version and its adoption status.
The activity and the software or other technical result have separate records.
The work’s coordination frame refers to domain models with their own meaning and owners.
